description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class 'TaskExecutorConfig' that configures two ThreadPoolTaskExecutor beans for task execution within the Fineract application, utilizing properties from FineractProperties.

classes.name: TaskExecutorConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class for setting up thread pool task executors within the Fineract infrastructure.

methods.name: fineractDefaultThreadPoolTaskExecutor
methods.description: Creates and configures a ThreadPoolTaskExecutor bean with default settings, with the bean name defined by TaskExecutorConstant.DEFAULT_TASK_EXECUTOR_BEAN_NAME.

methods.name: fineractConfigurableThreadPoolTaskExecutor
methods.description: Creates and configures a prototype-scoped ThreadPoolTaskExecutor bean with configurable settings, with the bean name defined by TaskExecutorConstant.CONFIGURABLE_TASK_EXECUTOR_BEAN_NAME.
